summary: Persist the first committed terminal rule-run, definition identity and display fields; export only saved evidence and add optional Issue revision checks.

public_contract_changes.contract: governance rule-run summary/results and Issue transition
public_contract_changes.description: Add optional rule_content_digest, persisted ifc_type/ifc_name, Issue revision and optional strict expected_revision. Preserve routes and callers that omit revision.

state_machine_changes.description: Only queued/running may commit a terminal state. First committed terminal state and result batch win atomically; stale writes cannot replace saved evidence.
Increment revision atomically with successful status transition and audit; optional expected_revision rejects stale writes without changing the allowed transitions.
